title: [Latest DEV] No BG value is shown in NS when BG Source is xDrip
body:
Nightscout: Latest DEV Version 15
xDrip source: Dexcom G5
AAPS: Latest DEV
Logs (check around 18:53:46):  [AndroidAPS_LOG_1687715846423.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/11860468/AndroidAPS_LOG_1687715846423.log.zip)

Now that xDrip can received all data from AAPS, I disabled NS upload and download in xDrip and I had set all upload to NS from AAPS but I can check that BG value isn't shown in NS, as screenshot below. As per NSV3 the BG value is sent.

NS should had received BG 90 but got stuck with 88. I don't know if had worked before because I always had xDrip to upload and download from NS. I would like to have AAPS dealing with this only.
